BiblicalUsage: Chaga is terror, a reeling fear — and it appears once, when Isaiah says the land of Judah will be a terror to Egypt, and everyone who mentions it will be afraid, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the counsel of the LORD is what makes Judah terrible to Egypt, not Judah's armies.
